target_customer: Commercial real estate investors, brokers, property managers and data centers
problem: Reading leases and property documents for key terms, costs, dates and risks is slow and manual. Propaya extracts structured data with citations and flags risks.
product_category: AI lease abstraction and property risk intelligence

founders.name: Reader Wang
founders.background_notes: Manages over 70 family rental properties per the YC page.

founders.name: Jake Golas
founders.background_notes: Met Reader Wang at Phillips Academy Andover in 2015 per the YC page.

competitors.name: Prophia
competitors.what: Commercial real estate data and lease abstraction platform

competitors.name: MRI Software Contract Intelligence (ex-Leverton)
competitors.what: Lease abstraction engine acquired from Leverton

technical_complexity.rationale: LLM document extraction with citations and risk taxonomies is standard applied AI in 2024, with some difficulty in accuracy and review workflows.

defensibility.rationale: Many lease abstraction vendors exist and general LLMs read leases well, so copying is easy.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents such as Prophia added instant AI abstraction in 2025 per its own post. No source on Propaya being bought.

market_need_then: Lease abstraction was a long-established paid service. The CTO and CEO's family property experience motivated the focus on building health risks such as mold and pests per the product site.

identity.voice_and_tone: Tagline 'Lease Review in Minutes', plain and functional

branding.community_and_virality: None found. The site footer says it is a Zzyzzx Inc. product.

brand_strength.rationale: No brand press or community found, and the name is easily confused with Papaya companies in search.

outcome_analysis: Propaya is Active as a two person team selling lease review to CRE firms, with named logos on its site. Only aggregators report about $500K in pre-seed funding. The market has established vendors that added AI features, so differentiation is the open question. There is no exit or failure signal and not enough evidence for a clear story.
notes: Funding unverified: VCBacked and Extruct list a $500K pre-seed from YC in September 2024; Tekedia Capital lists Propaya in its portfolio but no amount found. No round recorded. Prophia source is dated 2025, after the batch, so it shows an established vendor but is not a founding-date source; Prophia was founded 2018. MRI source is undated beyond 2024. Competitors Cadastral and LeaseLens had no dated sources near the batch.
